verdict: E2E-04 still FAIL, but the WebSocket-close hypothesis is disproved and two real defects were fixed.

runs.rootCause: The composer textarea is uncontrolled. Playwright fill() updated the DOM and the reducer synchronously, but the send click read the pre-render props draft, whose text was still empty, so the first message carried the image attachment without its text part. Mock then answered the fallback rule.
runs.fix: src/hc/client/conversation/view.cljs: composer-snapshot reads the live textarea value and overwrites the snapshot text; request-send! and stop-and-send use it.
runs.afterFix: The next run passed reply1, reply2, reply3 and every edit/version/blob check.

runs.assertion: branch second reply mismatch: E2E04-REPLY-3 (stale source third reply)
runs.rootCause: The source session's third RUN_FINISHED never ended the client stream. The branch view keeps the last assistant bubble in '正在生成' and shows the stop-and-send decision card, so sending the branch prompt only set a local decision and never dispatched a command.

evidence.failSync: identical to branchSyncBeforeSend: phase synced, transport open
evidence.failConnectionBadgeAtCatch: 连接状态：已同步；打开设置
evidence.decisionCard: 当前轮仍在生成 / 停止当前轮并发送 / 继续编辑

websocket.clientCloseAtShutdown: HC-WS-CLOSE {:code 1006, :reason "", :clean? false} after app exit (ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED reconnect)

runs.conclusion: This failure is not a WebSocket close, not a channel interruption, and not the 1006/1001 direction question. The transport and the sync adapter stayed healthy; the run-finished projection did not finish the client stream.

fixesApplied.change: http-kit 2.8.0 invokes closeRingHandler with two arguments (code, reason). The previous three-argument callback threw ArityException inside the http-kit executor and was swallowed, so [hc-ws-close] never printed. Fixed to two arguments; added a status-keyword log through Sente's :on-close wrapper and an explicit marker when http-kit already owns the ring handler slot.
composer-snapshot uses the live textarea value; send and stop-and-send submit the text the operator sees.
Debug log HC-WS-STATE with old/new open?, open-change? and last-close for every :chsk/state.
HC-WS-CLOSE now prints even when :last-ws-close is missing, including phase/reason/closed?/last-close; added read-only window.__HC_SYNC__ probe (phase, transport status, seq, last outcome).
Captures /chsk WebSocket open/close events, records __HC_SYNC__ before the branch send and at failure, plus failUsers/failAssistants/failConnectionBadge in the result JSON.

final28Requirements: Fix the missing RUN_FINISHED projection for the source third run: either the publisher never sends it or the client reducer drops it; the client stream must leave :streaming? and clear the stop-and-send decision before a branch send.
Rebuild the release bundle after these client changes (current resources/public/js/main.js is a dev compile dated 2026-11-08 21:16 CST).
Re-run E2E-04 serially with CHROME_PATH=/usr/bin/google-chrome; expected checks: reply1..3 true, branchReply2/3 true, mock has the 分支第二轮 request.

Keep or downgrade the new diagnostics: [hc-ws-close], [hc-ws-close-status], HC-WS-STATE and __HC_SYNC__ are read-only and safe, but HC-WS-CLOSE at error level fires on every teardown; consider info level once the WS question is closed.
